description: Angular component for managing time series chart thresholds in a widget configuration UI, including form handling, validation, and data key management.

classes.name: TimeSeriesChartThresholdsPanelComponent
classes.description: Angular component for editing and validating time series chart thresholds, with form controls and data key management.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group and subscribes to value changes for thresholds.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback for when the form value changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Placeholder for registering touch callback (not implemented).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls based on input.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the form controls based on provided threshold data, updating data keys as needed.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form group, returning validation errors if invalid.

methods.name: thresholdsFormArray
methods.description: Returns the form array of thresholds.

methods.name: trackByThreshold
methods.description: Track function for threshold controls in ngFor.

methods.name: removeThreshold
methods.description: Removes a threshold at a specified index.

methods.name: addThreshold
methods.description: Adds a new threshold with default settings.

methods.name: prepareThresholdsFormArray
methods.description: Creates a form array from a list of thresholds.

methods.name: checkLatestDataKeys
methods.description: Filters thresholds to include only valid latest key thresholds.

methods.name: updateLatestDataKeys
methods.description: Updates the datasource's latest data keys based on current thresholds.

methods.name: isThresholdKey
methods.description: Checks if a data key matches a threshold's latest key.
